The main landing page for it is:

**https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/audio/overview**

That's the "Audio" section overview (batch + realtime speech-to-text, diarization, word-level timestamps, context biasing). From there the sub-pages you'll probably want:

- Offline/batch transcription: https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/audio/speech_to_text/offline_transcription
- Realtime transcription: https://docs.mistral.ai/capabilities/audio/speech_to_text/realtime_transcription
- API endpoint reference: https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/audio/transcriptions

One caveat: Mistral reorganized their docs, so you'll also see older `/capabilities/audio_transcription` URLs floating around in blog posts and forum answers — those generally redirect into the `/studio/audio/...` tree now.

**https://docs.mistral.ai/capabilities/audio/speech_to_text**

That's the page titled "Audio & Transcription" — it covers speech-to-text with Voxtral (offline/batch transcription with diarization, word-level timestamps, context biasing, plus the realtime low-latency variant).

Two related paths worth knowing, since Mistral has been reshuffling their docs into a `/studio/` tree: the section overview now also lives at https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/audio/overview, and the raw endpoint reference is at https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/audio/transcriptions. If the first link redirects, the `/studio/audio/` one is where it lands.

**https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/audio/overview**

That's the "Audio" section of the Mistral docs, covering the Voxtral family — transcription (offline/batch and realtime), TTS, and audio understanding. From there:

- Speech-to-text landing: https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/audio/speech_to_text
- Offline/batch transcription: https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/audio/speech_to_text/offline_transcription
- Raw API endpoint reference: https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/audio/transcriptions

Note that Mistral reorganized their docs — the page used to live under `/capabilities/audio/` (that's where the "Audio & Transcription" title comes from), and older links now point into the `/studio/audio/` tree.

Those still resolve to the same material but the /studio/ paths are the ones I'd bookmark.

The page is titled "Agents & Conversations" and lives in the Studio API section of Mistral's docs:

**https://docs.mistral.ai/studio-api/agents/agents-api**

It covers creating agents (system prompt + tools + completion params), the stateful conversations API, handoffs between agents, and code snippets for both `agent_id`-based and direct-model conversations. If you land on an older link like `docs.mistral.ai/agents/agents_basics/`, that's the pre-reorg path for the same content.

Sources:
- [Agents & Conversations | Mistral Docs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio-api/agents/agents-api)
- [Agents Introduction | Mistral Docs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/introduction)
- [Beta Conversations endpoint reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/beta/conversations)

It covers creating an Agent object (instructions, tools, completion params), getting back an agent ID, and then starting/continuing stateful Conversations — including conversations started directly from a model without creating an agent first.

One heads-up: Mistral reorganized their docs, so you'll still find the old path `docs.mistral.ai/agents/agents_basics` floating around in blog posts and search results. Same content, older URL structure — if a link like that 404s, look for the equivalent page under `/studio-api/agents/`. The neighboring pages worth skimming are the Agents introduction and the built-in connectors (code execution, web search, image generation, document library).

Mistral's own docs put AWS Bedrock under their "Deployment → Cloud" section:

https://docs.mistral.ai/deployment/cloud/aws

That page ("Amazon Bedrock") covers the prerequisites (an AWS account in a region where Bedrock offers the model you want, an IAM principal with the right permissions), local setup with the AWS CLI + boto3, and how to call the models through Bedrock's Converse API. The sibling index at https://docs.mistral.ai/deployment/cloud lists the other managed options (Azure AI, Vertex AI, SageMaker) if you need those.

If you'd rather work from AWS's side, https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/mistral/ and the Bedrock user guide's Mistral examples (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/service_code_examples_bedrock-runtime_mistral_ai.html) have per-model cards and runtime code samples.

Sources:
- [Amazon Bedrock — Mistral AI docs](https://docs.mistral.ai/deployment/cloud/aws)
- [Cloud deployment index — Mistral AI docs](https://docs.mistral.ai/deployment/cloud)
- [Mistral AI for Amazon Bedrock Runtime — AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/service_code_examples_bedrock-runtime_mistral_ai.html)
- [Mistral AI on Amazon Bedrock — AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/mistral/)

Mistral's Amazon Bedrock page lives under the "Deployment → Cloud" section of their docs:
